specification.objective: Replace the persistent audit end-of-results notice with an accessible temporary notification.

requirements.statement: Notify once on a current successful end with results, temporarily and accessibly, including first and later pages; suppress empty and error responses and obsolete requests.

Preserve pagination, filters, errors, details, other messages and routes; handle retry and keyboard focus without stealing changed focus, and suppress obsolete covered-route notices. A completion queued before a route is covered must remain suppressed after returning, without removing unrelated notifications. Detect route coverage even when push and pop occur in the same frame via Navigator events.
Store an identical locked contract copy.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Tests cover temporary notification, page transitions, empty and error, refresh, obsolete responses and themes and widths. Assert the notification text is exposed in the semantics tree.

Regression tests exercise Navigator push/pop, unrelated messages, retry and keyboard focus including focus changes during requests. Exercise a queued completion across push and pop while an unrelated snackbar remains visible. Repeat push and pop without an intervening frame and verify unrelated snackbar semantics.
The committed-path contract matches the lock byte-for-byte.

invariants.statement: Do not expose personal data or alter pagination, filters, error and detail behavior.

forbidden_states.statement: Persistent notice, spurious stale notification or lost keyboard focus.

outputs.statement: Temporary accessible end notice and regression tests.

failure_semantics.statement: Errors and empty datasets do not announce completion.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; sys.exit(0 if Path("docs/contracts/audit-end-notification-v1.polis.json").is_file() else 1)
